name: Single Sign On for WP | Login With SSO
author: keywoot

sections.description:
Keywoot offers a WordPress Single Sign On (SSO) plugin that enables users to login/register on your WordPress site via SAML SSO with various Identity Providers (IdPs). Our plugin supports SAML 2.0 compliant IdPs such as Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID, Azure AD B2C, Okta, GSuite / Google Apps / Google Workspace, Salesforce, Keycloak, ADFS, Shibboleth, Office 365, OneLogin, Auth0, and many more.
This plugin transforms your WordPress site into a SAML Service Provider (SP), enabling it to securely authenticate users through any SAML 2.0-compliant IdP. This plugin ensures a seamless, secure, and hassle-free login experience for your users, It’s ideal for businesses, educational institutions, or community sites that need streamlined access for employees, students, or members.

Why use this plugin

  • Streamlined Login Process: Users log in once via their Identity Provider and gain instant access to your WordPress site.
  • Security First: Built on the secure SAML 2.0 protocol, ensuring your user data stays protected.
  • No User Limits: Whether you have a small team or a large organization, this plugin handles unlimited users with ease.

Supported Identity Providers (IdP) for WordPress Single Sign-On (SAML SSO)

The Single Sign-On for WordPress (WP SSO) plugin supports the following SAML 2.0-compliant Identity Providers (IdPs):

  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Azure AD
  • Ping Identity
  • Salesforce
  • ADFS
  • Office 365
  • Keycloak
  • OneLogin
  • Centrify
  • Ping Federate
  • Auth0
  • Azure AD B2C
  • Shibboleth
  • Gluu Server
  • SimpleSAMLphp
  • OpenAM
  • RSA SecureID
  • Bitium
  • Oracle Identity Cloud
  • NetIQ
  • WSO2
  • Any SAML Compliant IDP

With these integrations, your WordPress site becomes a secure and versatile hub for user authentication.

WordPress Single Sign-On (WordPress SSO)

Simplify your WordPress login with a single set of credentials:

Key Features of WP SSO:

  • Simplified Login: Easy access of WordPress with WordPress Single Sign-On (SSO). Authenticate via any SAML 2.0 compliant IdP to avoid multiple passwords.
  • Effortless Auto-Login: Users authenticated through another SAML service can access your WordPress site without extra logins.
  • Versatile IdP Compatibility: Supports SAML Identity Providers like Azure AD, Azure B2C, ADFS, Keycloak, GSuite/Google Apps, Okta, Salesforce, Office 365, Shibboleth, Auth0, and more.
  • Unlimited SSO Authentications: Automate logins with any SAML IdP.
  • Maps Required WordPress Attribute: Plugin mape Required wordpress attributes like email and usename with NameID Required from the Identity Provider.

Premium Features:

  • Advanced Attribute Mapping: Detailed control over user profile attributes of a user, Map user attribute from IDP to User user attributes of WordPress.
  • Advanced Role Mapping: Assign roles to singing on using sso based on SAML IdP groups or attibute.
  • Auto-Redirect to IdP: Redirect users to IdP for authentication and enforce single sign-on on site visit.
  • Single Logout : Logout from all the sessions and IDP in one click.
  • Force Authentication : Authenticate The user on IDP each time they login even if the IDP login session exists
  • Custom Redirection: Custom Redirection to any page after single sign on and single logout.
  • Restrict Access (Attribute Based): Restrict user based the a certain attribute value from idp.
  • Restrict Access( Domain Based) : Restrict the user from login to wordpress based on the domain in the email of the user
  • Multiple EnvironMment: Add Multiple Environments like Dev, Stagging and Prod.
  • Metadata Synchronization: Upload and sync IdP metadata easily on regular intervals automatically.
  • Custom Certificates: Add and use custom X.509 certificates for extra security.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Navigate to Dashboard > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for keywoot saml sso. Locate and install WP-SSO | Single Sign On for WP | Login With SSO.
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page.

From WordPress.org

  1. Download WP-SSO | Single Sign On for WP | Login With SSO.
  2. Unzip the downloaded file and upload the keywoot-saml-sso directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the SSO plugin from your Plugins page
sections.faq:
Is it possible to customize the SSO button for WP login Page

Yes, We support the customization of the SSO button in our Premium plan.

Is it possible to add SSO on any other page other than WP login page

Yes, We provide links and Shortcode so that you can add SSO login on any page

Is it possible to Redirect user to a certain page after SSO Login

Yes, This feature is available in our premium plans.
